messages:
Priya: FYI ran the nightly link-checker, caught a couple of stale shortlinks and one image 403 in docs/kb/batching.md. low effort to patch but wanted to see whos around to own it today?
Evan: I can take the shortlink fixes. which shortlinks are they?
Priya: looks like /kb/batch-tuning (old) -> should point at /kb/batch-tuning-v2, and /guides/runbook#batching-example -> the fragment changed after the last edit. grep hint: `rg "batch-tuning" -n docs/`
Lena: Ill rehost the image that's 403. seems to be `https://legacy-cdn/redwood/batching-diagram.png`. we should move to `/assets/img/batching-diagram-2026.png`.
Priya: perfect. Evan, can you also add a one-line note to docs/CHANGES.md so we have an audit trail? small bullet: "fixed broken shortlinks and rehosted batching image"
Evan: yep. Ill open a single PR with all three fixes + changelog. reviewers: @Lena @Kai.
DocsBot: nightly-link-scan: 3 issues found (2 shortlinks, 1 external asset 403) at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z
Kai: quick ask for PR: please include the original failing URLs in the PR description so we can trace back. also add a tiny test in docs/.github/workflows/linkcheck.yml? optional.
Evan: will paste failing URLs in the description and add a one-liner to the workflow (disabled by default) so we can enable quick checks during content PRs.
Lena: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4333 - summary: replace image, update fragments/shortlinks, add changelog bullet. tagging @Kai for quick review and @Priya for verification.
Priya: thanks! I verified the staging preview (image shows, fragments resolved). leaving a tiny editorial nit: change "its" -> "it's" on line ~42 (sentence about KV cache).
Evan: fixed editorial nit, pushed. @Kai requesting review.
Kai: approved. merged and deployed to staging. :rocket:
Priya: closing loop. will add the failing URLs to the internal ticket so the link scanner's false-positive rate can be tracked. thanks all.
